pricing_model: 0% markup pass-through on tokens + a flat monthly platform fee
note: Token costs through Anoman equal the provider prices in pricing.json — Anoman adds 0% markup on tokens. The flat platform fee below is what you pay on top for the guarded gateway: prompt-injection + PII guardrails on every call, observability, batch routing, IDR (Rupiah) billing with no international card, and in-region (Jakarta) processing for UU PDP data residency. OpenRouter-style aggregators add 5-20% token markup instead.

weighted_token_multipliers._comment: Anoman meters usage in WEIGHTED tokens: weighted = raw * provider_multiplier * model_class_multiplier * routing_mode_multiplier. A tier's monthly allowance is expressed in weighted tokens.

tiers.name: Pay-As-You-Go
tiers.overage: raw provider cost + 0-5% volume markup (still 2-5x cheaper than OpenRouter)
